subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a percussion instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sarod.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarod** is not a percussion instrument whereas Mridangam, Tabla, and Ghatam are **percussion instruments**.
 
• In percussion, the sound is produced by striking the animal skin which has been stretched across an earthen or metal pot or a wooden barrel or frame.
 
• The main categories are-
 
 
• Oordhwaka,
 
• Ankya,
 
• Alingya, and
 
• the waisted or the Damaru family of drums
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tabla** pair is a set of two vertical Oordhwaka drums.
 
• **Ankya drums** are held horizontally before the musician and usually, both sides are covered with animal hide.
 
• **Oordhwaka drums** are placed vertically before the musician and sound is produced by striking them with sticks or fingers.
 
• **Alingya drums** have the animal hide fixed to a wooden round frame and are embraced or held close to the body with one hand while the other hand is used for playing the instrument.
 
• **Damru family** is also known as the hourglass variety of drums as their shape resembles an hourglass.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea9dab231bacb90443f7815bbd6e9af2762117c9714ed485d416439aba22297e.png]
